newsitem.title: USA: Fed refrains from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed refrains from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York refrained from open market operations on Wednesday, primary dealers said.

The Fed's absence in the market came as no surprise to a large part of Wall Street analysts. Other pundits, however, had predicted earlier the Fed could add on Wednesday via eight-day system repurchase agreements.
At 1130 EST/1630 GMT, the time the Fed usually intervenes in the market, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-1/4 percent, in line with the central bank's target.
